data.narrative:
Pivot Bio is a Series C-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Alvin Tamsir and Karsten Temme that has raised $921M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer set of 3 private robotics & manufacturing companies at the same stage (Hadrian, Agile Robots, Nimble Robotics), supplemented by a broader comparable universe of 8 private firms and 1 public reference point.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $921M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $1.6B. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-stage, same-sector comparables produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with the peer range spanning $1.0B to $1.6B. The two methods converge meaningfully, with stage-progression anchored at the upper bound and peer-median at the lower-middle range.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation band of $850M (low) to $1.8B (high), with a median point of $1.3B. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-company peer set for Pivot Bio's specific subsector positioning, and whether the $921M raised sufficiently reflects prior valuation marks or represents a blended average across multiple rounds. Investors should calibrate these results against deal-specific unit economics, customer concentration, and competitive positioning within the broader robotics ecosystem.
